This is a big improvement — it really captures what I was after. The automatic page details with a sensible fallback title, the read-later flow, the smarter searching, sorting, selecting several at once, and the formatted notes are all there the way I imagined. And I'm fine with saving offline copies, reusable searches, and browser import/export coming in a later round.

Two smaller things about tags I want to make sure are covered, since I'll be leaning on tags a lot:

- When I'm typing a tag onto a bookmark, I'd like it to suggest tags I've already used so I pick the existing one instead of accidentally creating a slightly different duplicate.
- And when I see a tag on a bookmark in the list, I'd like to be able to click it and have the library narrow down to just that tag, without typing a search.

I saw searching by tag and filtering by tag mentioned, so the second one may already be the intent — I just want it to be an easy click, not only something I type. Could you fold those two in? Once those are reflected, I'm happy with the specification and you can move on to the plan.
